text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Vietnam wants to sell food and medicine to Iraq and buy oil under the second phase of Iraq's oil-for-food deal with the United Nations.
- World oil markets are waiting for the flow of Iraqi oil under the deal.
- European Union allocates $300 million to fund humanitarian projects in Iraq.
(The above were also carried by THAWRA and IRAQ)
- A group of Egyptian industrialists arrive in Baghdad to conclude trade pacts under Iraq's oil deal.
- Commentary on the seventh anniversary of imposing the U.N. sanctions on Iraq.
BABEL (Owned by President Saddam Hussein's son Uday)
